 for _, keyword in ipairs(GRIEF_KEYWORDS) do
  if lower:find(keyword, 1, true) then return true end
 end
 return false
end

local antigActive = false
local antigTriggered = false
local autoGatherActive = false
local gatherConnection = nil
local function dropAll()
 local char = LP.Character or LP.CharacterAdded:Wait()
 local backpack = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
 if not backpack then return end
 for _, v in pairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
  if v:IsA("Tool") then pcall(function() v.Parent = char end) end
 end

  if v:IsA("Tool") then pcall(function() v.Parent = workspace end) end
 end
end

local function disarmAll()
 if antigTriggered then return end
 antigTriggered = true
 dropAll()
 task.wait(3)
 antigTriggered = false
end

local function startAutoGather()
 if gatherConnection then return end
 gatherConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
  pcall(function()
   local char = LP.Character
   local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
   if not root then return end
   for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
    if obj:IsA("Tool") or obj:IsA("Model") then
     local handle = obj:FindFirstChild("Handle") or obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("BasePart")
     if handle then
      local playerOwner = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(obj.Parent)
      if not playerOwner then
       handle.CFrame = root.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
      end
     end
    end
   end
  end)
 end)
end

local function stopAutoGather()
 if gatherConnection then
  gatherConnection:Disconnect()
  gatherConnection = nil
 end
end

local function listenForCommands()
 local general = getGeneral()
 if not general then return end

 general.MessageReceived:Connect(function(message)
  if not message.TextSource then return end

  local text = (message.Text or ""):lower():gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
  local isOwn = message.TextSource.UserId == LP.UserId

  if isOwn then
   if text == "!autogi" then
    if not autoGatherActive then
     autoGatherActive = true
     startAutoGather()
     sendChat("Auto Gather: ON")
    end
    return
   elseif text == "!stopautogi" then
    if autoGatherActive then
     autoGatherActive = false
     stopAutoGather()
     sendChat("Auto Gather: OFF")
    end
    return
   elseif text == "!antig" then
    if not antigActive then
     antigActive = true

    end
    return
   elseif text == "!stopantig" then
    if antigActive then
     antigActive = false
     sendChat("Grief Detector: OFF")
    end
    return
   end
  end

  if not isOwn and antigActive then
   if containsGriefWord(text) then
    task.spawn(disarmAll)
   end
  end
 end)
end

listenForCommands()

    if iSB(m) then return "bot",m end
    if iCM(m) then return "custom",m end
    return nil

    return m.Name or "?"

-- AIM TARGETING
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function gCT()
    local cl=nil
    local bs=math.huge
    local vp=CAM.ViewportSize
    local cx,cy=vp.X/2,vp.Y/2
    local ch=LP.Character
    local rt=ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local pp=rt and rt.Position or CAM.CFrame.Position
    local tg={}
    for i=#CP,1,-1 do
        local t=CP[i]
        if not t.aimPart or not t.aimPart.Parent then table.remove(CP,i)
        else tg[#tg+1]=t end
    end
    if B1 then
        for m,e in pairs(CBset) do
            if not e.aimPart or not e.aimPart.Parent then rSB(m)
            else tg[#tg+1]=e end
        end
        if E3 then
            for m,e in pairs(CMset) do
                if not e.aimPart or not e.aimPart.Parent then rCM(m)
                else tg[#tg+1]=e end
            end
        end
    end
    for _,t in ipairs(tg) do
        local ap=t.aimPart
        local pos=ap.Position
        local sp,os=CAM:WorldToViewportPoint(pos)
        if os then
            local dx,dy=sp.X-cx,sp.Y-cy
            local ds=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)
            local ddx,ddy,ddz=pp.X-pos.X,pp.Y-pos.Y,pp.Z-pos.Z
            local wd=math.sqrt(ddx*ddx+ddy*ddy+ddz*ddz)
            local ef=gF(wd)
            if ds<=ef then
                local sc=ds+wd*0.04
                if sc<bs then
                    bs=sc
                    cl=t
                    CD=wd
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return cl
end

local function lT()
    if CT and CT.aimPart and CT.aimPart.Parent then
        local ap=CT.aimPart
        local tp=ap.Position
        if PR then
            local v=ap.Velocity or Vector3.new(0,0,0)
            local pd=math.clamp(0.05+(CD/2000),0.02,0.1)
            tp=tp+(v*pd)
        end
        CAM.CFrame=CAM.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.new(CAM.CFrame.Position,tp),SM)
    else
        CT=nil
    end
end

    "MEH SHARK", "GHOST", "MASTER"
}

local function generateLine()
    if pattern == "" then pattern = "_" end
    local result = ""
    while #result < 150 do
        result = result .. pattern
    end
    return string.sub(result, 1, 150)
end

local function startTMXSpam()
    if saying then return end
    saying = true
    sendChatMessage(targetName .. " SPAMMER STARTED 👑")
    task.wait(0.1)

    spamThread = task.spawn(function()
        while saying do
            local randomMsg = tmxMessages[math.random(1, #tmxMessages)]
            local msg = generateLine().."\n"..targetName.." "..randomMsg
            sendChatMessage(msg)
            task.wait(math.max(delayTime, 0.2))

    end)

        TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 10, 10)}):Play()
    end)
    return input
end

local function createButton(text, color, order)

    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.LayoutOrder = order

    local darkenColor = Color3.new(color.R * 0.7, color.G * 0.7, color.B * 0.7)

    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = lightenColor}):Play()
    end)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = color}):Play()
    end)
    btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {BackgroundColor3 = darkenColor}):Play()

delayInput:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()

patternInput:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
